# Chris Tregaskis

> Chris Tregaskis is a senior full-stack TypeScript developer who works end to end across the stack (front end, back end, AI agents and the cloud underneath), building things properly and shipping them quickly with AI tooling in the workflow. He helps small and medium businesses get more from the software they already have: adding AI where it earns its place, improving what's there, or proving an idea with a focused prototype.

This site is one long page. Each section below links to its anchor on that page.

## Work

- [Wayfinder](https://chris-tregaskis.uk/#work): an AI guide for a global automotive brand. A chat assistant live in production, guiding buyers on electric and hybrid options across the range; test-drive booking and finance were proven in the prototype and demoed live. Built end to end by Chris from a reusable white-label foundation: React widget, Node API with a PII layer that redacts personal details before anything reaches a model, a supervisor agent routing to specialist agents, tools over MCP, infrastructure in Terraform. The page includes an interactive figure of the architecture that comes apart, each part into its named and numbered pieces, a scripted chat demo and how it was built (spec, plan, AI-assisted build one step at a time, review gates, ship, plus an eval bench of conversation scenarios run before every release).
- [Physio and wellness](https://chris-tregaskis.uk/#physio): a multi-tenant platform for physio and wellness, a start-up Chris is building with a physiotherapist. Organisations pay for their people to work through physio-designed exercise programmes that keep them moving, with preventing falls as the aim. Every organisation runs on one codebase and one Postgres database, its data kept to itself by row-level security. React, Zod, Drizzle, SST and Turborepo. In build.
- [Badass Burpees](https://chris-tregaskis.uk/#burpees): a fitness app Chris built for himself and shares with everyone for free. Set the reps and the time you have and it paces you, counting you through every one. Its interface is built from atomic components.
  - [badass-burpees.app](https://badass-burpees.app/): the live app.
  - [Design system](https://badass-burpees.app/design): its atomic design system (tokens, components, figure).

## About

- [About](https://chris-tregaskis.uk/#about): a full-stack TypeScript developer who loves turning a rough idea into something people use. Lately that means AI: agents, MCP tooling and chat products.

## Contact
